column1: # TAXONOMY: the words this project uses, from three places, in one file, none renamed to suit another.
# origin  game: the game and its mod (Bryant's code and docs) · garden: Bryant and Alfred's working words
#         lab: Corwin's lab (C4), physics and chess · branch: coined on the recipe branch
# status  fixed: the game's own word, not ours to move · pinned: its keeper has ruled on it
#         hand-turning: in use, meaning offered, waiting for its keeper's word
# bridge  the nearest term from another origin, and how they differ ("=" same thing, "~" kin, "!=" an isotope:
#         the same spelling weighing differently in two places, kept apart on purpose)
